description: Complete NetBSD DRM2 Nouveau PCI, display, firmware, memory-management, power-management, and NVKM driver imported through the EdgeOS BSD Driver Bridge.

patches.reason: Use the BSD bridge anonymous-inode stub on FreeBSD and keep NetBSD power-switch registration private to NetBSD.
Use the bridge module owner because FreeBSD LinuxKPI device drivers do not carry Linux module ownership.
Skip Linux pid and address-space bookkeeping that is not represented by the FreeBSD LinuxKPI file ABI.
Use FreeBSD LinuxKPI reservation APIs and disable unsupported generic shmem page backing while preserving TTM-backed GEM.
Use the FreeBSD LinuxKPI interval-tree insertion helper and isolate NetBSD rbtree metadata.
Skip Linux address-space sharing that is not represented by the FreeBSD dma-buf file ABI.
Use the typed FreeBSD device logger and omit unavailable debugfs register dumps.
Keep optional fbdev console emulation disabled while preserving the complete Nouveau DRM and render driver.
Provide LinuxKPI device-class plumbing for DRM minors on EdgeOS while retaining NetBSD connector event behavior.
Use LinuxKPI allocation primitives for the NetBSD DRM client adapter on EdgeOS.
